description: Inputs for originating our own lines. Every constant is either a figure OLBG publishes on the cited page, or an explicit MODEL ASSUMPTION that is surfaced as such in the site and in data/flagged.json. Nothing here is copied from a bookmaker price.

confidence.note: anything below the medium floor is LOW

Tennis.total_basis: MODEL ASSUMPTION: 22.5 total games for a best-of-three match; not published on the captured source
Tennis.margin_basis: MODEL ASSUMPTION: 6-game average winning margin; not published on the captured source

Basketball.total_basis: MODEL ASSUMPTION: 225.5 points; OLBG publishes no league average total on the captured page
Basketball.margin_basis: MODEL ASSUMPTION: 9-point average winning margin; not published on the captured source

Cricket.total_basis: MODEL ASSUMPTION: 320.5 combined runs (T20/ODI mixed card); not published on the captured source
Cricket.margin_basis: MODEL ASSUMPTION: 20-run average winning margin; not published on the captured source

Snooker.total_basis: MODEL ASSUMPTION: 9.5 frames for a best-of-11; OLBG publishes the 6-5 scoreline frequency (23.9%) but not an average total
Snooker.margin_basis: OLBG published average winning margin, Masters last 16 best-of-11: 3.01 frames - https://www.olbg.com/betting-tips/Snooker/8

Rugby Union.total_basis: OLBG published average total points, Premiership: 54.0 - https://www.olbg.com/betting-tips/Rugby_Union/9
Rugby Union.margin_basis: OLBG published average winning margin, Premiership: 15.2 - https://www.olbg.com/betting-tips/Rugby_Union/9

Rugby League.total_basis: OLBG published average total points, Super League: 42.0 - https://www.olbg.com/betting-tips/Rugby_League/10
Rugby League.margin_basis: OLBG published average margin, Super League: 18.4 - https://www.olbg.com/betting-tips/Rugby_League/10
Rugby League.base_rates_basis: OLBG published Super League home/away/level-after-80 rates - https://www.olbg.com/betting-tips/Rugby_League/10

Ice Hockey.total_basis: OLBG states NHL totals are commonly set around 6.0 (used as the modelling baseline) - https://www.olbg.com/betting-tips/Ice_Hockey/13
Ice Hockey.margin_basis: OLBG states the NHL puck line is usually 1.5 - https://www.olbg.com/betting-tips/Ice_Hockey/13

Darts.total_basis: MODEL ASSUMPTION: 9.5 legs for a best-of-11; OLBG's own highlighted total-legs line on this card is 9.50 - https://www.olbg.com/betting-tips/Darts/15
Darts.margin_basis: MODEL ASSUMPTION: 2.5-leg average winning margin on a best-of-11

Handball.total_basis: OLBG published average goals per game, EHF Champions League men: 60.82 - https://www.olbg.com/betting-tips/Handball/20
Handball.margin_basis: OLBG published average winning margin, EHF Champions League men: 5.04 - https://www.olbg.com/betting-tips/Handball/20
Handball.base_rates_basis: OLBG published EHF Champions League men split: favourites 68.2%, underdogs 22.0%, ties 9.8%. Home/away shares are NOT published by OLBG; the 0.50/0.402 split here is a MODEL ASSUMPTION that preserves the published 9.8% tie rate within a 100% book - https://www.olbg.com/betting-tips/Handball/20

Volleyball.total_basis: MODEL ASSUMPTION: 175.5 total points across a best-of-five; not published on the captured source
Volleyball.margin_basis: MODEL ASSUMPTION: 12-point average margin across sets

Greyhounds.total_basis: Not applicable: a six-dog race has no two-team total. Left blank rather than invented.
Greyhounds.margin_basis: Not applicable: no handicap market for graded six-dog races.

Baseball.total_basis: OLBG uses 8.5 runs as its worked example of a baseball game total - https://www.olbg.com/betting-tips/Baseball/12
Baseball.margin_basis: OLBG states the favourite is usually given a 1.5-run handicap - https://www.olbg.com/betting-tips/Baseball/12
Baseball.base_rates_basis: OLBG published MLB home win 59% / road 57% (i.e. home teams win slightly more games than they lose at home); the 0.545 prior is a MODEL ASSUMPTION inside that published range - https://www.olbg.com/betting-tips/Baseball/12
